mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_execution_human_request (id, request_key, task_id, project_id, request_type, title, content, risk_level, status, requested_by, assigned_to, expires_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{requestKey}, #{taskId}, #{projectId}, #{requestType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{riskLevel}, #{status}, #{requestedBy}, #{assignedTo}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at = updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_execution_human_request WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND request_key = #{requestKey}
SELECT * FROM ai_execution_human_request WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_execution_human_request WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_execution_human_request SET status = #{status}, response = #{response}, responded_by = #{respondedBy}, responded_at = #{respondedAt}, updated_at = #{respondedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
